scope: Opt-in semantic and action-boundary JSON recovery qualification using archived FPT physical parameters and unchanged head; no retraining, no benefit inference
domain: archived IID public task domain; freshly generated bytes in isolated qualification/worlds
required_order: Publish source, protocol and PREPARED_FREEZE plus five opt-in artifacts before generating worlds
reset_contract: continuous truncated Gaussian, sd=.12*boundary, archived fitted reset centers; explicitly differs from archived finite folded-bin reset
driver: pre-action completed last_symbol/reliability only; completion only after continuous interval
head: unchanged archived first_passage_bank head; real continuous x -> nine free endpoint call probabilities, normalized position, two mode flags
structured_value: replace only STOP/SUBMIT_0/SUBMIT_1 scores by 0/1-2p/2p-1 from own learned belief; continuation outputs unchanged
checkpoint: JSON of Owner.state/receipts plus continuous voltage/mode/residual refractory and PCG64; bind public and artifact hashes
acceptance: Every prefix boundary, including initial and terminal, must replay suffix and final checkpoint exactly in every non-timing field; retain all original and replay timing fields
raw_evidence: all generated public/evaluator/packet files; original and every-boundary replay full receipts, continuous event times, costs, reads and checkpoints
exclusions: Do not access control campaign confirmation or its models/worlds. No task gain, gradient, Rust, cold process, energy or production claim. JSON restore in same Python process qualifies serializable action-boundary state only.
